page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.r7.8xlarge is a memory-optimized server instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 32 dedicated vCPUs mapped to 32 physical cores using an Intel Xeon 8369B processor running at 2.7 GHz. The architecture is x86_64, supported by a cache hierarchy of 48 KB L1d, 1 MB L2, and 48 MB L3 cache. The instance is equipped with 256.0 GB of system memory, yielding a high memory-to-core ratio of 8.0 GB per core. It does not include local storage or dedicated GPU hardware, relying instead on network-attached storage and a baseline network bandwidth of 16 Gbps.

In benchmark evaluations, the ecs.r7.8xlarge demonstrates solid mid-range performance. Its stress-ng single-core CPU performance score is 1865.39, while the multi-core score reaches 30983.52. Memory bandwidth tests show a read-only small block cached speed of 1689.81 GB/sec, which drops to 141.73 GB/sec for large uncached blocks, and a write speed of 65.94 GB/sec. For database operations, the instance achieves a PassMark database score of 13455.54 and processes 30.13 million Redis SET operations per second. In language model tasks, it processes 135M model text generation at a strong rate of 282.15 tokens per second, though larger 7B model text generation drops to an average of 17.54 tokens per second.

The qualitative cost efficiency of this instance is driven by its high memory density. By offering 256 GB of RAM alongside 32 vCPUs, it allows memory-intensive applications to scale without requiring the purchase of excess compute resources. However, the lack of bundled local storage represents a key tradeoff, as users must factor in the latency and cost of external block storage. The instance is highly appropriate for memory-intensive workloads such as in-memory databases, caching layers, large-scale data processing, and enterprise application hosting.
